retrieved_chunks.text:
DKU Library Guide (January 2025 brochure)

This document copies service hours and space facts from the January 2025 DKU Library Guide PDF. Where it disagrees with the later Locations & Hours website, treat the website as current and this brochure as dated January 2025.

Library building: Monday-Sunday 08:00-23:00. Side gates use swipe access. The guide lists 23 self and group study rooms and 560 seats.

retrieved_chunks.title: Registrar Fall 2026
retrieved_chunks.text:
DKU Registrar — Fall 2026 dates

Undergraduate and graduate classes begin Monday, 24 August 2026.

New international undergraduate students (Class of 2030) and international first-year graduate students move in Friday, 14 August 2026 at 09:00. New Chinese undergraduate and Chinese first-year graduate students move in Sunday, 16 August 2026 at 09:00. Returning students move in Friday, 21 August 2026 at 09:00.

retrieved_chunks.title: Conference Center
retrieved_chunks.text:
Duke Kunshan University Conference Center

The Conference Center is on the DKU campus in Kunshan. It has over 200 guest rooms, a gym, and on-campus parking. The auditorium holds up to 300 guests. The grand ballroom can be divided into two rooms.

Dining venues named for Conference Center guests include the Conference Center Restaurant, Executive Dining Restaurant, and Water Pavilion. A campus restaurant and a Family Mart in the Community Center are also mentioned.

retrieved_chunks.title: Dayu Bay
retrieved_chunks.text:
Dayu Bay commercial center

Dayu Bay is a short walk from the DKU campus. The commencement visitor guide gives the walking distance as 500 meters. Visitors may park for free in the Dayu Bay commercial center parking lot.

The guide says an array of restaurants is located there. This local note does not name any restaurant, does not list opening hours, and does not list prices.

Source: https://commencement.dukekunshan.edu.cn/plan-your-visit/ (retrieved 2026-09-10)

retrieved_chunks.title: Registrar Spring 2027
retrieved_chunks.text:
DKU Registrar — Spring 2027 dates

All residence halls reopen Saturday, 9 January 2027 at 09:00. Undergraduate and graduate classes begin Monday, 11 January 2027.

Spring Festival Holiday: no classes Friday 5 February 2027 through Sunday 14 February 2027. Classes resume Monday 15 February 2027.

Graduate and undergraduate commencement is Friday, 21 May 2027. All residence halls close Saturday, 22 May 2027 at 13:00.

Qing Ming (Tomb Sweeping Day): no classes Monday 5 April 2027.
